purpose: Bounded retrieval characterization; it does not establish answer quality or production reliability.

corpus.source_granularity: Each source is one baseline chunk and one GraphRAG document version.

methods.configuration: BM25 plus configured dense embedding, RRF k=60, no query rewriting
LightRAG aquery_data mode=mix, top_k=40, chunk_top_k=20, SDK rerank disabled

retrieval.required_source_metric: Recall@3 = retrieved required source IDs divided by required source IDs
retrieval.unanswerable_metric: Recall is null; report retrieved source count and whether any source was returned.
retrieval.duplicate_policy: Source IDs are deduplicated in first-retrieved order before scoring.

answering.reason: Current documented comparison interfaces expose retrieval data but no shared answer-generation and citation boundary.
answering.required_if_added_later: Store generated answer, verified citations, provider token usage when returned, and a separately defined answer-quality rubric.

execution.provider_failure: Stop on the first provider failure, write STATUS.json, and do not change provider, model, seed, or method.
execution.isolation: Use a new temporary Chroma directory and unique disposable PostgreSQL workspaces. Never read or write user collections.
execution.token_usage: Record only usage returned by an invoked interface; otherwise store null with an unavailable reason.
